summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K regarding private exchange agreements with Uptown Capital and Streeterville Capital, exchanging portions of existing royalty interests for newly issued Series Q Perpetual Preferred Stock. Uptown received 500 shares in exchange for a $12.5M royalty reduction; Streeterville received 148 and 260 shares for a combined $10.2M reduction. The Series Q Preferred is exchangeable or redeemable for common stock per a Certificate of Designation. No price, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed. The transaction is a debt-for-equity swap, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution from future conversions.
